title: Lifelike Agility and Play in Quadrupedal Robots using Reinforcement Learning and Generative Pre-trained Models

archiveComparison.method: Compared complete publisher archive member with downloaded GitHub file. Publisher uses CRLF and GitHub LF; bytes equal after CRLF-to-LF normalization. No other normalization.

licenseStatus.figshare: CC BY 4.0, explicitly assigned to the dataset by the publisher record and API.
licenseStatus.github: README also says code and data are for research purpose only. LICENSE.txt describes MIT for software. These statements are not conflated.
licenseStatus.currentScope: Local research prototype. No deployment authorized.
licenseStatus.attribution: Motion source: Lei Han et al. (2024), Lifelike Agility and Play in Quadrupedal Robots using Reinforcement Learning and Generative Pre-trained Models, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24968946.v1, CC BY 4.0. Changes: selected frames, evaluated BVH hierarchy, projected selected joints into 2D; no retiming or loop correction.
licenseStatus.publisherComparison: Publisher and GitHub full clip match exactly after CRLF-to-LF normalization. Final input is the publisher archive member.

selection.method: Endpoint pose plus tangent mismatch on forward upright intervals; require circular phase difference between same-side fore/hind forward extrema between .23 and .42 cycles.
selection.score: 2D endpoint RMS position error + 0.4 * RMS endpoint tangent difference (one-frame tangent scaled by 10).

excludedSources: Any source dog mesh or private photographs

licenseEvidence.publisherDescription: The dataset contains raw .bvh motion clips collected by motion capture system.
licenseEvidence.githubReadmeExcerpt: The code and data in this repository are for research purpose only.
